content: Piyush Goyal says India-EU Free Trade Agreement will create opportunities for farmers, fishermen, MSMEs, startups, women entrepreneurs, manufacturers and service providers across India and Europe

title: Farmers’ union to mobilise one million ‘swayamsevaks’ to fight trade deals
content: SKM leaders said delegations have met more than 100 Ministers, MPs, and MLAs across the country with a charter of demands that includes cancellation of all FTAs

title: Kerala High Court  welcomes renaming of mental health centres as ‘happiness and wellness centres’
content: “We are sure that the change of name will catalyse the change that we want to see,” says a Division Bench of Justice Devan Ramachandran and Justice Basant Balaji

title: From asteroid hunter to Maths wizard, 82 educators to receive National Teachers’ Awards
content: Teachers who engage in creative pedagogy and community leadership are in focus; among awardees are faculty in Indian Knowledge Systems, including Vaastu Shastra, the Bhagavad Gita, and integrating Sanskrit with AI

title: Supreme Court pushes for raising retirement age in district judiciary to 62 as case backlog exceeds five crore
content: Top court says it is ‘crying need of the hour’ to stop attrition of experienced judicial talent otherwise access to justice would remain a mere chimera due to unfilled posts; only 7 States, including T.N and Karnataka, have responded positively to the SOS

title: More than a week after Nepal’s deadliest flood disaster in years, here’s what we know so far
content: More than a week after catastrophic floods struck Nepal, rescue teams continue searching for the missing as authorities assess the scale of destruction. Here’s a look at what caused the disaster, the latest casualty figures, and the ongoing relief and recovery efforts.

title: A string of non-academic tasks take teachers away from classrooms
content: Non-academic tasks assigned to teachers, latest being SIR, has forced them to least engage in their primary responsibility in schools and colleges

title: Climate change a common challenge, says government on Nepal Minister’s compensation demand
content: External Affairs Ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said developed countries responsible for emissions must “take the lead” and support developing nations through finance and technology transfer

title: Kochi metro needs 17 more train rakes for Kakkanad, airport extensions
content: The additional rakes will be needed to maintain a train frequency of six to seven minutes on the proposed 11.20-km Pink Line to Kakkanad and the subsequent 19-km airport extension; only five to eight rakes would be sufficient for the Kakkanad corridor

title: Keralam seeks Sadya emoji, eyes global branding for traditional feast
content: Kerala Tourism requests Apple CEO John Ternus, who assumed office on September 1, to include an emoji representing Keralam’s Sadya on iPhone. Request made through the official social media handle of Kerala Tourism in response to a post by Ternus after assuming the office

title: Villagers drag, beat crocodile driven ashore by shrinking Tungabhadra in Andhra’s Kurnool
content: The falling river is bringing crocodiles onto the banks; DFO P. Shyamala asks people to call forest officials instead of chasing, catching or beating them

title: Safety concerns grow as Kochi roads see repeat violence involving bus crew
content: At least five cases of alleged assaults and road rage involving private bus crew reported in Kochi in past two months; police and MVD step up enforcement

title: Andhra Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan directs APPCB to study water pollution in Godavari River
content: The APPCB will collect water samples from the Godavari, 15 main drains and 45 minor drains for scientific analysis to document the levels and sources of pollution
